svg.title: Delayed feedback and selective admission change evidence
svg.desc: Independent fluid-delay and six-job serial references • no hardware timing
svg.text: Delayed feedback and selective admission change evidence
Independent fluid-delay and six-job serial references • no hardware timing
A remote pause arrives too late
Queue sixty; hard limit eighty
Net growth 600/s × 50 ms = thirty
Four extra in flight → fourteen excess
A local gate still owns the bound
Reject or bound excess in another domain
Pressure high sixty / low thirty
Health and dwell also gate recovery
Unlimited waiting: six jobs at time zero
One worker; each job takes two ms
Visible terminals: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 ms
Six-ms limit: three useful out of six
One active and two waiting: three rejects
Accepted terminals: 2, 4, 6 ms
Useful / admitted = three / three
Useful / offered still three / six
Queue protection and admitted success can improve while offered-service attainment does not.
The reference burst is not sustainable capacity, a p99 sample or measured feedback behavior.
